name: Emergency Response Australia
desc:
🇦🇺 Welcome to Redgum Australia! An open-world driving and emergency responders roleplay experience.

🚗 Drive, explore & go off-road
Choose from a growing range of iconic Australian vehicles. Cruise around town, hit the back roads, or take your 4WD off-road outside Redgum.

🚔 Choose your side
Crime is causing chaos across town. Join the Police and help keep Redgum under control — or become the reason they're needed.

💰 Live the criminal life
Track down the criminal dealer hidden somewhere around the map and see what they've got in stock. Steal vehicles, rob stores, make money and escape the police before you're caught.

🔨 Update Log: 11/10/2026
🚙 New Crash System!
You can now crash into streetlights, garbage bins, fire hydrants and if your vehicle takes enough damage, it will catch on Fire!
Firefighters will receive a call for a vehicle alight, and will be able to respond and p- New wanted system with stars.
💰 New Robbery Minigames!
New minigame for ATM robbery & now rob safes!
